notes: Workshop: a steel jig frame with T-slot rails and four clamps round a half-built chassis (bolt circle, motor boss). The clamps press in turn (N, E, S, W) with a violet toggle lever flipping, and a weld spark runs round the joint. Damaged: the east clamp arm is bent, the chassis is knocked out of true, a rail is cracked and the weld sparks. Disabled: clamps flung open and dead, the chassis fallen into pieces on the table.
